content: Listen to "Going On A Date" here: https://stayleveldistro.com/nsp_goingonadate Animated by @shoocharu SUBSCRIBE FOR MORE MUSIC PATREON: https://www.patreon.com/nsp SUBSCRIBE: https://laylo.com/ninjasexparty MERCH: http://ninjasexparty.com/store TOUR: https://ninjasexparty.com/tour/ SPOTIFY: https://stayleveldistro.com/nsp_spotify INSTAGRAM: https://www.instagram.com/ninjasexparty/ TWITTER: https://twitter.com/ninjasexparty FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/ninjasexparty TIKTOK: https://www.tiktok.com/@nspband MUSIC Written by Dan Avidan, Brian Wecht, Jim Roach Dan Avidan - Vocals Brian Wecht - Organ Jim Roach - Producer, Mixer, Engineer, Guitar, Drums, Bass Kat Ostenberg - Vocals Tom Moffett - Trumpet Doctor Sung - Synthesizer Lord Phobos - Lap Steel Guitar Justin Shturtz - Mastering Engineer Maurice Soque - Engineer LYRICS: Hey Jennifer! Hi! I’ve been looking forward to this date for a long time. That’s why I got here on time, even though I just got out of the hospital for emergency penis reduction surgery. A lot of anesthesia had to be used. And on top of that, a lot of anesthesia had to be used. Let me tell you what I’ve got planned for us tonight. Great! Planes are very high Night is like dark day Dogs are always very close Unless they’re far away Blue and red are colors But also so is green Sandwiches are bread With things that’s in between We’re going on a date We’re going on a date Whee Danny, are you ok? You seem heavily sedated Oh yeah I’m good, so good Uh, okay. Why don’t you tell me a little bit about yourself You got it, Godzilla Your body filters blood Thanks to your friend the spleen Robots are like zombies But not dead, and are machines Many insects’ sense of smell Is done though their antenna Tailia is a bad last name If your first name is Jenna TRUMPET SOLO! Attention, the museum will be closing in fifteen minutes. That’s not a trumpet. Who’s this guy think he’s kidding? We’re going on a date (snoring) We’re going on a date Yay-yay We’re going – whoops We’re going on a date We’re going on…uhhh…oh, I fucking know this I’m having the time of my life He’s perfect in every way I can’t believe we just met today He sees the world in a different light He’s a free spirit like a dove I think I might be falling in love Potatoes are big I threw up at the zoo Love me chicken tender Love me chicken true I could eat a baseball If I had enough time My favorite kind of poetry Is when all the words sound the same We’re going on a date We’re going on a date Date We should do this again. How about Friday? Friday. What…is…that?
